mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate investments, which in turn negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts over two consecutive months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which positively impacts the S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as related industries benefit.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between HOUST increases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a reduction in supply-side capacity, leading to increased prices and reduced corporate profits, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between INDPRO declines and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of real personal consumption expenditures indicates strong consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between RSAFS levels and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of rising unemployment rate and falling nonfarm payrolls indicates a weakening labor market, leading to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3% and PAYEMS falls > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint effect of UNRATE and PAYEMS on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL) and rising federal funds rate indicates a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate investments, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint effect of CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal where a decline in GDP during a period of economic expansion signals a potential slowdown, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between GDPC1 declines and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) during late-cycle expansions.
